dependencies.rule: PIR/EIR/MIDP/TIDP and LOD/LOI determine which containers exist, delivery timing, and segmentation demand; S4 creates deterministic identities for those containers.
S8 supplies semantic parameter definitions and the Shared Parameter Registry; S4 may consume those values as identity carriers without redefining semantic ownership.
S4 governs names and identity of files and containers placed within S3 CDE structures.
S4 discipline, system, zone, and level identity tokens support coordination filters, clash sets, and issue attribution.
S4 container identity, revision, and suitability dimensions propagate into formal transmittal and handover records.
